steps.title: Find a model
steps.note: Search Hugging Face from the Models screen. Capabilities are read from the announcements and traced, and a VRAM verdict tells you whether it fits before you download.

steps.title: Download it
steps.note: Resumable, multi-part aware, into a named volume. The local registry and a disk inventory keep track of what you already have.

steps.title: Load it
steps.note: The plan appears with its justification: how many layers on the GPU, what context, which cache. The frontend displays it, it never recomputes it.

steps.title: Talk, and give it tools
steps.note: Streaming answers, branches and non-destructive edits, and eleven tools you enable per conversation, each with its token cost measured by the loaded model's own tokenizer.
